articles.title: Braves place Martín Pérez on injured list 6 days before postseason
articles.description: The Braves hope he can return this postseason, but the injury is a blow for the lefty who is having one of the best seasons of his career.

articles.title: Braves clinch postseason berth with win in Houston as depth endures through trying season
articles.description: After missing the playoffs last season for the first time in eight years, Atlanta nailed down a spot in this year's postseason field.

articles.title: Ronald Acuña Jr. is hot. Grant Holmes is healthy. The Braves are 1 win from NL East title
articles.description: There's some really good things going on, and some guys are stepping up," manager Walt Weiss said. Acuña and Holmes are among them.

articles.title: After ‘three slaps in the face,’ Astros slugger Yordan Alvarez speaks up to stop a spiral
articles.description: Alvarez is one of the Astros' leaders by example, but he delivered a "personal" message after the Braves swept Houston on Sunday.
